description_extension.message: Warns you when a site imitates a bank protected by Codebyr OS.

ressemble.message: This site ($HOTE$) looks like your bank's site ($BANQUE$) but it is not the official one.

deguise.message: Its address imitates ordinary letters with characters from another alphabet, or accented ones: behind its appearance, it is spelled “$HOTE$”.

jamais.message: Never enter your credentials here. For your bank, use the Codebyr OS Bank Space.

legitime.message: This site is legitimate, don't warn me again

refus_onglet.message: Site not in the list — Codebyr

refus_titre.message: This site is not in the list of the “$ESPACE$” Space

refus_titre_sans_nom.message: This site is not in this Space's list

refus_detail.message: Codebyr did not open $HOTE$: this Space only opens the sites you have allowed in it.

refus_ajouter.message: If it belongs to your bank: Seal menu → Codebyr Settings → “Sites blocked”, click the + next to its name, then close and reopen this Space.

refus_ailleurs.message: Otherwise, open it in the Browsing Space.
